Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.player.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game, identified by a unique nickname and a totem color. Each player owns a Tribu that accumulates resources and characters during the game.

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, Totem totem)
      Creates a new player with the given nickname and totem. A fresh, empty Tribu is automatically created.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's unique display name
      totem - the totem color assigned to this player
